content.text: Tax compliance built for global business Powerful automation, deep expertise, and continuous compliance are built into every transaction to keep you aligned, adaptive, and audit-ready. Vertex O Series Tax Engine and Indirect Tax Accelerator now available on Oracle Marketplace for faster global tax deployment. LEARN MORE A platform built for every step of the tax lifecycle Take control of global indirect tax operations with a single platform that streamlines real-time determination, compliance, and audit readiness - minimizing complexity and adapting to changing regulations. Explore our platform Data & content Tax-Sensitized data powers smarter global compliance Is your tax data powering smarter compliance across your business? Tax-sensitized data ensures every transaction across your financial system is accurate, compliant, and audit-ready. Vertex connects real-time rates, rules, exemptions, and cross-border logic directly to your ERP and financial processes. This helps you reduce risk, maintain agility, and transform tax complexity into a competitive advantage. Explore our solution Tax determination Drive accurate and compliant transactions in real time Vertex automates tax determination across products, jurisdictions, and systems. Whether you're selling online, processing invoices, or managing procurement, Vertex ensures accurate tax every step of the way — without slowing your team down. Optimize global tax determination Returns & reporting Translate calculation data into compliant reporting From invoicing to yearly reports and period filings, Vertex handles the details. Automatically generate and validate tax-compliant invoices and returns tailored to local regulations. Submit directly to tax authorities, manage real-time status tracking, and automate return generation across multiple jurisdictions. Stay compliant with evolving regulatory demands while controlling overhead and minimizing audit exposure. Simplify compliance & reporting Audit & planning Build a foundation for better decisions Build stronger control over your tax position. Tax isn’t just about compliance. It’s about control. With centralized data, real-time reporting, and full audit traceability, Vertex helps you understand your tax position and prepare for whatever comes next. Strengthen your audit & planning strategy Integrations Integrate tax automation into your existing workflow Vertex integrates with leading ERP, eCommerce, procurement, and financial systems, embedding tax automation directly into your operational processes. Our modern, API-ready platform connects structured tax data across your business, helping you maintain continuous compliance and improve accuracy without disrupting existing workflows. Explore our partners Stay connected with our global e-invoicing solution. Automate and simplify real-time reporting with software that integrates with leading, enterprise-level ERP systems. Maintain continuous VAT/GST compliance with a single, global solution. Comply with new and changing CTC mandates as they evolve. Create and streamline continuous e-invoicing processes. Discover e-invoicing Blog Post Leading the Charge: E-Invoicing as the Cornerstone of Future Compliance Kathya Capote Peimbert on why now is the time to transform your e-invoicing and compliance strategy. Customer Story Ford Takes Its Vertex Tax Engine Global Learn how Ford integrates SAP and Vertex to manage tax on a global scale. On-Demand Webcast Future-Proof Your Business: Leveraging SAP Cloud ERP & Vertex for Smarter Growth Learn how SAP Cloud ERP and Vertex simplify migration, boost efficiency, and align tax processes with business growth. Our solutions enable continuous compliance at every stage of the tax lifecycle. Let us help you manage global tax compliance with confidence.
